objectives: Course introduction: This course is designed to enable students to effectively grasp the current hot topics and future developments of civil law and commercial law in Taiwan. In addition, in commercial law, we will focus on the latest issues of company law, bankruptcy law, and securities regulations, so that students can truly understand the development trend of Taiwan‘s current commercial law.
content:
Topics in this course include (but are not limited to) the following:
1. Civil law: typical and atypical contracts, properties and security interests, matrimonial regime, successional and legally reserved portions, etc.
2. Company law: directors‘ duty of care and duty of loyalty.
3. Bankruptcy Law: Voluntary and Involuntary Bankruptcy, Discharge, Rehabilitation, and Liquidation Procedures of the Consumer Debt Clearance Act.
4. Securities Regulations: Mergers and Acquisitions, Insider Trading.
books: The Modern Bankruptcy, Albert Yu-Wei Cheng, Angle Publish Co., 2022.
